_comment: Series metadata, kept separate from the per-question quiz CSV because a
series is its own entity: it exists whether or not any of its books have
quizzes, and its length is a fact about the series rather than about a
totalBooks is the denominator for series-progress display. null means
'not known yet' and is a legitimate permanent value — an open-ended or
still-running series has no total. A null total must render as a count
('4 books read') and never as a fraction or a percentage.
